summary.text: Sarah Stalker is a Democratic state representative from Kentucky House District 34 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Republican Victoria Ligon.
She works as a consultant and has a background in the nonprofit sector.

paragraphs.text: In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Sarah Stalker said she was born and raised in Louisville, grew up attending public schools, and graduated from Stephens College for Women in Columbia, Missouri.
She said she returned to Louisville after living in Los Angeles and Chicago, and that her experience in the nonprofit sector and as a foster parent led her to run.

Her career experience includes working as a consultant with On Purpose Consulting, LLC, as director of community engagement and membership of the Center for Nonprofit Excellence, and as a radio show co-host with Crescent Hill Radio.
Stalker succeeded Democrat Mary Lou Marzian in District 34.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House Agriculture, Families and Children, House Local Government and Postsecondary Education committees.
In her 2022 survey she said she was passionate about protecting women and children and about addressing child abuse in Kentucky.
